description: Write a structured client status report for a consulting engagement. Use when a consultant says "write my weekly status update", "I need to send a status report", "draft the client update", "what should be in the weekly report", "client wants a progress update", "help me write the RAG status", "I need to report on blockers", "end of week update to the client", or "help me communicate what's stuck". Also trigger when someone needs to communicate engagement progress, surface blockers to the client, or flag decisions that need to be made by the sponsor.
